militaristic.label: Militaristic
militaristic.summary: Keeps a 15% larger standing army that rebuilds 50% faster; marches only when at least as strong as the foe, and rarely sues for peace

peaceful.label: Peaceful
peaceful.summary: Rarely expands or fights; trades widely

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.summary: Expands and declares war often, sometimes recklessly
